verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion is a fair privacy question for any app, including a local iOS terminal, so the axis applies. The evidence documents no product-level retention or deletion controls, such as clearing command history or wiping app data. The only related item is the user-scripted `.profile` startup hook, which the docs say could be used to clean up temporary files. That is a user-side workaround, not a product capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: You can use this mechanism to customize further, e.g. have custom environment variables or cleanup temporary files.
